shortDescription: Execute CLI commands on Huawei VRP devices

options.name: commands
options.description: List of CLI commands to run. Each entry can be either a plain string or a dictionary with keys C(command), C(prompt), and C(answer). Use dictionaries for interactive commands such as confirmations.

options.name: match
options.description: Whether C(any) or C(all) conditions in C(wait_for) must be true.

options.name: retries
options.description: Maximum number of retries to check the conditions.

options.name: wait_for
options.description: Conditions to wait for in the command output before returning success. Example: C(result[0] contains "OK") Or: C(result[1] not contains "Error") Errors in wait_for expressions may not include precise position hints.
